fear: Python security release posted to blog and not seen

answers.content: {"type": "checkable", "fear": "Python security release posted to blog and not seen", "deadline": "2026-10-01T00:00Z", "route": "watch", "signal": "blog Python RSS feed updated"}

```json
{"adapters": [{"name": "rss", "params": {"url": "https://blog.python.org/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss"}}], "interval_s": 300}
```

```python
from watcher_runtime import harness
from watcher_runtime.adapters import rss

URL = "https://blog.python.org/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss"

try:
    feed = rss.fetch(URL)
except Exception as exc:
    harness.fail("Could not read the Python blog RSS feed.")
else:
    items = feed.get("items", [])
    state = harness.load_state()
    seen = set(state.get("seen_guids", []))

    # First run: establish baseline without alerting
    if not seen:
        harness.save_state({"seen_guids": [i.get("guid") for i in items if i.get("guid")]})
        harness.emit("ok", "Baseline set for Python blog RSS feed.", "blog.python.org", next_check_s=300)
    else:
        # Find new items since last check
        new_items = [item for item in items if item.get("guid") and item.get("guid") not in seen]
        if new_items:
            # Update seen set with new guids
            updated_seen = seen.union({item.get("guid") for item in new_items if item.get("guid")})
            harness.save_state({"seen_guids": list(updated_seen)})
            harness.emit(
                "act_now",
                "New post on Python blog – check for a security release.",
                "blog.python.org",
                {"new_titles": [item.get("title") for item in new_items]},
                next_check_s=300,
                fear_came_true=True
            )
        else:
            harness.emit("ok", "No new posts on Python blog.", "blog.python.org", next_check_s=300)
```

```python
from watcher_runtime import harness

URL = "https://blog.python.org/feeds/posts/default?alt=rss"

            updated_guids = seen_guids + new_guids
            harness.save_state({"seen_guids": updated_guids})
            harness.emit(
                "act_now",
                "New post on Python blog – check for a security release.",
                "blog.python.org",
                {"new_titles": [item["title"] for item in new_items]},
                next_check_s=300,
                fear_came_true=True
```
